notes: «قال سألت ابن عمرو بن العاص أخبرني» makes Ibn Amr the one asked and answering, a link after Urwa, the asker
«تابعه ابن إسحاق» follows the saying with its own isnad: a second group, not a variant; «قلت» is Urwa asking Abd Allah b. Amr
«وقال عبدة ... قيل لعمرو بن العاص» is a different transmitter for the same saying: variant; its passive «قيل» leaves the speaker unclear, so Amr is not added
«وقال محمد بن عمرو عن أبي سلمة» is a variant with a different transmitter: variant group
